svg.title: TextDART × SCANNER — four-sample regional feedback
svg.desc: The same four constructed examples and computed scores as the project-page interactive demo. TextDART displays defect-aware regional rewards. SCANNER normalizes each target across the four samples, including clean-reference rewards for absent extra text, applies token-support normalization, and mixes global and regional advantages as omega decreases from one to zero.

g.text: Localize text, mark malformed glyphs and score each region.
Compare each target across all four images, then mix global and regional advantages.
